Tara: Quick heads-up — joint webinar with SkyStack + TerraGrid on Tue 11am PT. Need final runbook, speaker mic checks, demo fallbacks, and swag pickup plan.
Ben: Got it. Are we on for the marketplace announcement tie-in?
Tara: Yes — marketing will push the cloud marketplace listing immediately after the keynote. We need a 2-paragraph partner blurb approved by EOD Fri.
Maria: I have the draft blurb, dropping it here for edits. Also need speaker bios (60-80 words) and headshots.
Kevin: I can collect bios from partners. Quick ask: who owns the press ops (embargo timing + press list)?
Lina: Partnership ops will own press distribution. I'll sync with marketing. Can someone confirm embargo window?
Ben: Marketing wants embargo lift at T+30 mins. Works?
Tara: T+30 mins is okay. Make sure marketplace listing goes live at T+35 to avoid clobbering indexing.
ops-bot: calendar: "Joint Webinar — SkyStack + TerraGrid x Redwood" invite posted for Tue 11:00 PT.
Maria: Running order suggestion in case folks want to copy:
Maria: ```
11:00 - Host intros (Tara)
11:05 - Partner announcements (SkyStack lead) 5m
11:10 - TerraGrid demo (10m)
11:20 - Live Q&A (15m)
11:35 - Closing + CTA to marketplace listing
```
Kevin: For demos — TerraGrid will show live infra deploy. We need a prerecorded fallback (30s clip) and a lightweight hosted demo if live fails. Who can provision fallback?
Ben: I can get a 30s screen recording uploaded to S3 and a simple hosted demo on our sandbox endpoint. Tag me once the recording is done.
Tara: Cool. Also logistics: swag pickup for partner reps is Friday AM from SF office. Lina, can you confirm courier + sticker packs count?
Lina: Booking courier now. How many packs? I have 20 Redwood + 20 partner. Need to confirm partner headcount.
Kevin: SkyStack bringing 3, TerraGrid 4. So total 27. Make it 30 to be safe.
Maria: Speaker mic checks — can we do a quick run Mon 3:00 PT? Short walk-through of mics, slide control, and NDI streams.
Ben: Mon 3 works for me. I'll bring a USB headset for the hosts.
Tara: Great. Also legal sign-off on partner logos in the slide deck — I pinged legal earlier, but need confirmation by Mon noon.
ops-bot: legal: document "partner-logo-release.pdf" uploaded to #legal-review.
Lina: Courier confirmed. Pickup Fri 9:30 AM, 30 sticker packs reserved.
Kevin: One more ops note — routing policy: if live demo latency spikes, auto-fallback to recorded clip at 11:12. Who monitors?
Ben: I'll monitor the demo route and trigger fallback if 95th percentile > 800ms for 2m.
Tara: Thanks. Post-webinar asks: record, trim to 20m highlight, publish on YouTube and marketplace listing with short embed. Maria, marketing to own.
Maria: Yep. I'll coordinate with SOC for captions and with video for edit.
Tara: Perfect. Anything else?
Ben: Can we add a short pre-event tweet and partner co-post at T-1 hour?
Lina: Scheduled: partner co-post and tweet at T-1h.
Kevin: All set on demos. I'll send the fallback clip link here once uploaded.
Maria: I'll drop speaker bios + headshots by Fri 5pm.
Tara: Awesome — thanks team. Final checklist: blurb (Maria) EOD Fri, legal logo signoff Mon noon, mic check Mon 3pm, swag pickup Fri 9:30am, embargo T+30, marketplace listing T+35.
Ben: Noted. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder set for Mon 3:00 PT — "Webinar mic check"
Tara: Closing the loop — we'll reconvene Mon after mic check if any last-minute items.
Kevin: 👍
Lina: 👍
Maria: 👍
